'''Ploo II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ploo sector/Legends|Ploo sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
[[File:AldarBeedo-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] from Ploo II.]]

Ploo II was inhabited by rod-thin aliens known as the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphids]], who plunged into war with the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrians]] of the neighboring planet [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]]. There were also [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]] living on Ploo II. Ploo II was the homeworld of the professor [[Murk Lundi]]. Podracer [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] lived on Ploo II. He raced in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] pursued [[Norval]] in the [[Ploo system/Legends|Ploo system]]. The young man had stolen a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron of King Adas|holocron]] and was trying to reach Ploo II, the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of his mentor [[Murk Lundi]]. Kenobi boarded Norval's vessel and took the holocron after defeating the aspiring [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in a brief [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Followers" />
